arg.name: backend
arg.description: carla | isaac: the simulator csb drives (roadmap 035); empty keeps the config file's (default carla; isaac is roadmap 037)

arg.name: isaac_endpoint
arg.description: backend isaac: the world server's ZMQ endpoint; empty keeps the config file's (default tcp://127.0.0.1:5590)

arg.name: isaac_render
arg.description: backend isaac: true | false, render every frame (for watching; an ego with a lidar renders anyway); empty keeps the config file's (default false)

arg.name: isaac_request_timeout_seconds
arg.description: backend isaac: how long a world server request may take before the bridge is wedged and exits for a fresh one; empty keeps the config file's (default 10)

arg.name: isaac_load_timeout_seconds
arg.description: backend isaac: the same for LoadWorld and an ego's Spawn; empty keeps the config file's (default 120)

arg.name: config_file
arg.description: bridge_config.yaml (CARLA, blueprint and map aliases, Traffic Manager, agent relay)

arg.name: carla_host
arg.description: CARLA host; empty keeps the config file's

arg.name: carla_port
arg.description: CARLA RPC port; empty keeps the config file's

arg.name: ssv2_port
arg.description: ZMQ port SSv2 connects to; empty keeps the config file's

arg.name: agent_relay
arg.description: tcp://host:port of the agent relay that drives entities with controller `agent`; empty keeps the config file's (default tcp://localhost:5560)

arg.name: npc_motion
arg.description: kinematic | tracked: how SSv2-driven NPC vehicles and pedestrians move in CARLA (roadmap 023); empty keeps the config file's (default tracked)

arg.name: weather
arg.description: CARLA weather preset (ClearNoon, CloudySunset, HardRainNight, ...) applied on connect and after every map load; empty keeps the config file's (default: leave CARLA's). Change at run time with /carla/set_weather

arg.name: gap_trace_dir
arg.description: where each episode's gap trace (roadmap 024) is written for gap_oracle; empty keeps the config file's (default: no trace)

arg.name: npc_contact_sensors
arg.description: true | false: a collision sensor on every tracked NPC vehicle, for the gap trace and oracle (roadmap 032); empty keeps the config file's (default true)

arg.name: contact_report_dir
arg.description: where each ego run's CARLA contacts are written for physical_verdict (roadmap 021); 'off' disables; empty keeps the config file's (default ~/.ros/csb/contacts)
